text:
Ravi (Design): dropped a new prototype for compact rule rows. main goal: make order + validation obvious without taking more vertical space. feedback welcome.
Nora (PM): saw it, nice work. quick question: during sim playback, can we indicate which rule fired and why? support gets a lot of "why did X route to Y" tickets.
Ravi (Design): yes — idea is a transient callout: rule name + short rationale (eg. "matched header X") anchored to the rule row. won't persist after playback.
Hiro (Frontend): adding a transient callout is doable. prefer it be part of the DOM near the row so we can animate it. avoid portal overlays that break scrolling.
Priya (Eng): backend note: sim currently returns match_id and confidence. we can add a snippet of the matched conditions (human readable) but need to cap length. maybe 140 chars.
Jamie (A11y): a11y note: any transient must be announced via SR. recommended pattern: update a role=status region with full sentence: "Preview: rule 'Block - large attachments' matched because file size > 50MB."
Ravi (Design): sample copy for the callout: "Matched: Block - large attachments — file size > 50MB." thoughts?
Nora (PM): that copy is solid. also +1 to capping backend snippet length. support often screenshots these so clarity matters.
Hiro (Frontend): styling notes: callout should be compact (max-width 360px), with a subtle shadow, and a 3px left accent bar to signal active. animation: fade + slide up 200ms. CSS draft: ```css
.rule-callout { max-width:360px; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); transform-origin: bottom left; transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s; }
```
Jamie (A11y): contrast check: if accent is the same as brand blue, ensure the callout text itself meets 4.5:1. if not, invert to dark bg + white text. Also keyboard users need a way to persist the callout (keyboard toggle) and a focus trap isn't needed, just focusable "Details" link.
Priya (Eng): concern about perf: showing callouts for each simulated request could be noisy. maybe show only for the first matched rule or when user clicks "highlight match" in sim controls.
Ravi (Design): proposal: show callout on hover/focus + auto-show for the first match during playback. we can also add a small "Show details" button to expand the snippet.
Hiro (Frontend): will implement hover/focus + auto-first-match. for click-to-expand we can lazy-load the full condition text.
Nora (PM): microcopy tweak: change global validation toast to "Policy check: X conflicts" -> inline row text: "Conflict with 'Allow - billing'" with a CTA "Show conflict details". customers read that better.
Jamie (A11y): keyboard ordering: when a rule is moved, announce full sentence: "Rule 'Allow - billing' moved from position three to position one." ensure aria-atomic=true. also the grab handle must be 44x44px touch target.
Ravi (Design): adding both a visible handle in compact mode + larger invisible hit area for touch. handle icon will have a label "Drag to reorder" for tooltip/aria.
Priya (Eng): implementation note: we should debounce order updates to server on reorder end (not during drag) to reduce churn. frontend can optimistically update UI.
Hiro (Frontend): agreed. will emit reorder events only on drop. also will add a small inline spinner while server commits.
ops-bot: Deployment reminder: UX branch merged to staging at 13:12 UTC. preview link: https://staging.redwood.ai/routing/sim-preview
Jamie (A11y): quick color nit: left accent should be #004EA8 for 4.5:1 against white. Ravi, can you update mock?
Ravi (Design): done — updated mock to #004EA8 and added "Show conflict details" copy. uploaded new images.
Nora (PM): let's review in the morning sync at 9:30. please flag any blocking a11y or perf concerns before then. thanks all!
